crime: Every morning and every dusk, one of the prisoners ran laps along the courtyard paths, and on every lap she circled back to run beside {WITCH_NAME}, who was always last.

One morning {WITCH_NAME} fell on the path and broke her ankle. From the ground she held out her hand so the runner could take it and feel the break as her own. The girl drew back, laughed, "I'll take your word for it," and ran on. {WITCH_NAME} was bandaged and carried down to her lower bunk.
Once, when she was small, she had held out a broken arm to her mother. Her mother pushed it aside, said, "It can't hurt that much," and made her walk home.

That evening, while the others were at supper, {WITCH_NAME} got up and walked on the broken ankle out to the dusk laps. As the runner came past, {WITCH_NAME} caught her wrist. The runner felt the broken ankle as her own and dropped on the path. {WITCH_NAME} closed both hands on her throat, and the pain pouring through those hands kept her down until she was still.

In the trial court, {WITCH_NAME} held out her hand to the others. Each girl who took it felt that ankle and dropped to her knees, sobbing. No one on an ankle like that could have left her bunk, the prisoners ruled; some other hand had strangled the runner at dusk.

But one girl, still kneeling with {WITCH_NAME}'s hand in hers, saw the gauze under her heel, worn through and gray with courtyard grit. Then they understood: she had walked on the very pain that dropped them, out to the dusk path and back.
fields.epitaph: The only one who felt her pain to the very end was the girl who would not take her hand.
execution: The execution stand raises a great iron treadwheel. She is shut inside, standing on her broken ankle. The wheel begins to turn, faster and faster, and she has to run on the ankle. When the ankle gives, the wheel carries her up and drops her onto its iron rungs, again and again. Around it, iron runners run their laps, past the hand she thrusts out between the spokes. None of them takes it. At last the wheel slows to a stop. She lies still across the bottom rungs, her hand still held out.

magic.name: Hand to Heart
magic.text: Anyone she touches feels exactly what she feels, body and heart, as if it were their own.
